title: AIADRA shared - Part feature record (ADR/0029 Part authoring SCN arc 20260531-13; per-parameter fact provenance per ADR/0044 A2 arc 20260717-2)
description: Parametric feature record carried in a Part's `feature` namespace + in `part_changed.feature_delta` operations. Shared across sidecar / Revision / event payload per the `acceptance_criterion_item.schema.json` precedent (ADR/0025 §5).

id.description: Stable list-addressable id per S0 commitment 7 (feat_NNNN; engine-allocated; immutable across the feature's lifetime within the Part).

feature_type.description: Engine-declared feature kind (e.g., 'sketch', 'extrude', 'fillet', 'chamfer', 'hole', 'pattern_linear'). aiadra-core does NOT enforce a closed enum per ADR/0029 D8 + ADR/0028 D4 op-kind pattern; each Native Engine declares its own catalog. feature_type is for human + AI labels; semantic interpretation is the Native Engine's responsibility.

depends_on_feature_ids.description: Per ADR/0029 D9 + Codex1 B6 absorption: multi-parent dependency-graph edges to other features in the SAME Part. Forms a directed acyclic graph (DAG) — fold enforces acyclicity over this array. Empty array = no dependencies (root feature; references reference geometry only). aiadra-core validates the DAG structure; the Native Engine's own kernel cares about semantic dependency content via adapter_payload.

datatype.description: Numeric-only for v0.28.0 per ADR/0029 N3. Future MINOR SCN can extend the enum when a load-bearing case surfaces.

category.description: Per ADR/0044 D3 + Amendment A2 (arc 20260717-2): OPTIONAL per-parameter fact provenance so dimensions authored by different actors within one feature (e.g. one sketch) are distinguishable. 'computed_result' is admitted here (unlike the feature-record level) because canonical weak-completion values are system-minted (weak_policy) while strong values are human/AI intent. 'measured' is excluded: reference dimensions are parameter-free derived measurements by ADR/0044 D3 and never appear in parameters[]. ABSENT means the feature-level fact_provenance is the provenance reading for this parameter (the pre-A2 default, unchanged).

fact_provenance.description: ADR/0044 A2 additive extension (arc 20260717-2, Gate F2a): optional per-parameter provenance. Existing records without it remain valid; absence = feature-level provenance applies.

parameters.description: Named scalar inputs driving this feature (extrude depth, fillet radius, etc.). Per ADR/0028 D8: caller-supplied design intent - the unit MUST be canonical (D10). Provenance: each item MAY carry its own fact_provenance per ADR/0044 D3/A2 (arc 20260717-2); when absent, the parent feature record's fact_provenance is the provenance reading for that parameter (the pre-A2 behavior, unchanged).

adapter_payload.description: Engine-opaque payload carrying the kernel-specific data (sketch primitives, BREP operation parameters, etc.). aiadra-core schema-validates only that it IS an object per ADR/0029 D7 + ADR/0028 D6 cache freshness + ADR/0027 D11 ecosystem-package boundary. The engine + adapter_schema_version fields pin the format. Structural / semantic validation is the Native Engine's responsibility.

engine.description: Native Engine discriminator per ADR/0005 §9 + ADR/0027 D18 wire-name preservation. Examples: 'mechanical-native', 'electrical-native'. Read-compatible with legacy values ('freecad', 'kicad') per the D18 reframing.

adapter_schema_version.description: Native Engine's adapter contract version. Pins adapter_payload format independently of the AIADRA canonical bundle version.

engine_artifact_ref.description: Optional Vault content-hash anchoring this feature to a portable engine artifact. Per ADR/0005 §9 anchor requirement: features may use stable_engine_object_id resolving within a referenced geometry artifact (whose own vault_ref provides the canonical anchor) when no direct engine_artifact_ref applies.

stable_engine_object_id.description: Optional engine-internal stable id portable across Workspaces. Per ADR/0005 §9.

status.description: Optional structural metadata per ADR/0029 D4 + Codex1 N1 absorption: absence is interpreted as 'active' by aiadra-core fold (no JSON Schema default annotation since defaults aren't written into sidecars). Native Engine decides any recompute semantics for suppressed features per Q8.

category.description: Per ADR/0029 D6 + ADR/0028 D8: feature records are caller-supplied design intent. category MUST be 'ai_proposal' if event actor=agent OR 'human_input' if event actor=human. Schema-rejects 'computed_result' and 'measured' at the feature level (those belong on geometry_ref records).
